flash-next-strata-solo-thinking-recovery.note: New on 2026-10-17, one variable from the card-sampling configuration of the day; since the 2026-10-18 consolidation it is the oldest link the Strata chain has left, and the configuration the retired greedy, card-sampling and route-tail-skip ids name in their refusal: TOOL_CALL_RECOVERY=on. Pinned from the day it exists, so a later edit to either configuration moves a digest here rather than going unnoticed. Re-pinned on 2026-10-17 again for three variables this container is now told through and nothing else moved: --conversation-cache-mib and --conversation-cache-min-free-mib, both stating off here, and --ple-gguf stating off. Stating off is what tells the entry point to take the flags out of the run config it wrote on an earlier boot; the three lines are here so every configuration of this engine says what the workspace it shares is left holding. Re-pinned on 2026-10-18 for the top of the session-size ladder: context_tokens to 262,144, the rung the ladder in docs/deployment.md measured, both configurations of this resident together because the run config is one file per workspace, and the capability profile name now says 256k because it states the window the model is served with.

New on 2026-10-17, one variable from flash-next-strata-solo-thinking-recovery: the conversation-cache budget moves from off to 16384 MiB, and with it the two refinements only an on cache has use for (--conversation-cache-slots 2, --conversation-cache-min-tokens 16384). This one does need the image this revision pins, because the flags go into the engine's run config and only this house's entry point can write there. Sized from this box's engine log; see the profile's own warning for what it buys and for the /metrics reading that says it is not buying it. Re-pinned with its sibling on 2026-10-18 for the same reason and on the same rung: the session window goes to 196608 in both, so the difference between the two stays the conversation-cache budget it was created for. Re-pinned on 2026-10-18 for the top of the session-size ladder: context_tokens to 262,144, the rung the ladder in docs/deployment.md measured, both configurations of this resident together because the run config is one file per workspace, and the capability profile name now says 256k because it states the window the model is served with.

New on 2026-10-18, one variable from flash-next-strata-solo-thinking-recovery-cache: the window goes to 524,288 and the ring that carries it is stated with it (--rope-scaling yarn --rope-scale 2.0 --yarn-orig-ctx 262144), because past 262,144 the pack's trained window ends and the wider promise is YaRN interpolation or nothing. Measured on this box the same day at exactly this factor (docs/deployment.md, "Beyond the ladder" and the factor table): boot 100 s, decode 119.5, a 493K-token tail question answered identically in five rounds. Needs the image this revision pins, because only this house's entry point writes the ring into the engine's run config -- and takes it back out for any profile that does not state one, which is what keeps the 256K sibling native. The 524,288 publication also required LLM Router to widen RESIDENT_CONTEXT_LIMIT first (llm-router 0d9dc83): a catalog above the router's ceiling is refused atomically, every model route answering 503 until it is repointed, so router first is the order, not a suggestion.

flash-next-strata-two-card-iq4-xs.note: New on 2026-10-20, not a rename: the two-card probe, which runs the resident's own pack, window and sampling preset on the RTX 3090 and RTX 4080 SUPER with the Everyday resident loaded on the other pair. Pinned at creation because it is the first paired configuration whose coding side is not llama.cpp, so its compose_sha256 is the first pin of the night-side resident beside a Strata backend -- the pairing the vision-GPU placement change made possible, and the one a later edit to that placement would move without touching a profile. It is also the first configuration to state the VRAM reserve, the control vector and the engine log path in source (overlay facts 9-11) instead of carrying them as hand edits inside a workspace.
